title: Bitter-Bright
summary: Radicchio, arugula, coffee, dark chocolate in savory — bitterness needs salt and fat.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — bitter-bright is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: bitter_green, acid, olive_oil. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Balance with sweet fruit or balsamic
Sweet and acid turn bitterness into complexity, not harshness.
